    Zhihua Wang

    Associate Professor at the School of Cyber Science and Technology, Shenzhen Campus of Sun Yat-sen University.

    • Shenzhen, China
    • Email
    • Twitter
    • LinkedIn

    Welcome to the Vision, Imaging, Perception & Security Laboratory (VIPS). We conduct research at the intersection of visual perception, computational imaging, and multimedia security. VIPS aims to advance next-generation multimedia perception and build secure, reliable AI systems.

    🧠 Research Interests

    • Computational Modeling of the Human Visual Perception
    • Perceptual Multimedia Signal Processing and Quality Assessment
    • Multimedia Quality-of-Experience
    • Camera Processing Pipeline Design and Optimization

    🧑‍🎓 Admissions

    I recruit 1–2 PhD students and 1–2 Master’s students each year, and I also welcome motivated bachelor students to join the group in any format. If you are interested in joining VIPS, please feel free to reach out via email.

    🔥 News

    • 2025.12:  I have moved to the School of Cyberscience and Technology at SYSU, where I am excited to begin a new chapter in my academic career and research journey.
